snippet.title: Cendovia Uprising Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Cendovia Uprising is going live on November 4th, 2025.  Be sure to check it out on Steam.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3140660/Cendovia_Uprising/

Cendovia Uprising is a turn-based tactical combat game where strategy rules the battlefield. Play as one of 10 factions, deploy troops with powerful cards, and adapt to changing terrain. Conquer over 50 unique battlefields, complete campaign missions, or test your skills in scrimmages and online PvP. Customize your deck, outsmart rivals, and lead your faction to victory!

Have fun!
